According to the IMD, the weather system is being influenced by a deep depression centred over northern interior Odisha and adjoining areas. It is expected to move across Odisha, Jharkhand and Chhattisgarh over the next 24 hours, strengthening monsoon activity across Vidarbha

The India Meteorological Department (IMD) has issued heavy rain alerts for several districts in the Vidarbha region of Maharashtra, warning of heavy to extremely heavy rainfall, thunderstorms, lightning and strong winds between July 28 and 31, 2026.
The weather department said a deep depression over eastern India is expected to move west-northwest, bringing widespread rainfall and the risk of flooding across the region.
